questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: The language of the destination was important to me, as i was mostly looking to improve my knowledge french in correspondance with my education.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: At times it was a bit difficult and we were informed of things like meetings etc. very late. We were sent information that was no longer relevant (concerning zoom meetings etc) which i needed to email them about before they told me it was for last year. In general a bit messy and uncoordonated

questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *

questions.answer: Not very easy. Luckily i knew a few people in Paris who helped me.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: It can be very difficult for foreigners to find apartments in Paris and very expensive.
